summary.text: A 13-year-old girl with moderate depression intentionally ingested about 10 clonazepam tablets and 8 lithium carbonate tablets, with weakness, limb tremors, altered consciousness, dizziness and nausea, and a Pediatric Severity Score of 2. Serum clonazepam was 165.0 μg/L at admission. Gastric lavage was done about 15 h after ingestion with activated charcoal, supportive care and flumazenil 0.2 mg; hemoperfusion for about 3.5 h followed with improved consciousness and a post-treatment level of 53.9 μg/L. She recovered and stayed 3 days.

summary.text: An 11-year-old girl with severe depression intentionally ingested 70 clonazepam tablets, with gait instability, poor mental status, mild respiratory acidosis and a Pediatric Severity Score of 1. Serum clonazepam was 236.9 μg/L at admission. Gastric lavage was done about 4 h after ingestion with activated charcoal and supportive care; blood purification with hemoperfusion and CVVH was given and mental status stayed stable, with a post-treatment level of 119.5 μg/L. The parents requested discharge for home observation; she recovered after 3 days.

summary.text: A 1-year-2-month-old girl accidentally ingested clonazepam, dose unknown, with gait instability, agitation, intermittent crying and restlessness and a Pediatric Severity Score of 2. Serum clonazepam was 32.8 μg/L at admission. Gastric lavage was done about 1 h after ingestion with activated charcoal and supportive care; blood purification was deemed unnecessary. She recovered and stayed 5 days.

article_limitations: Case 4 admission is stated as May 2023 while the methods give a 2024 study window; both are kept without correction.
The abstract states all four children had dizziness, vomiting and ataxia, but Table 1 manifestation lists differ; the abstract-only symptoms are kept as review-only source conflicts.
The source uses elimination half-life, elimination time and clearance interchangeably for the calculated 66.6-195.4 h and 40.7-118.7 h values; the Table 2 term is kept.
Narrative and Table 3 descriptions of case 2 blood purification (8 h hemoperfusion then CVVH; two combined sessions; 48 h total) are not reconciled.
The tablet strength of ingested clonazepam and lithium carbonate is not stated; no mg dose is inferred.
Caption-layer visual status not_inspected; the three table JPEGs were inspected in the separate visual target.
No neurological sequelae were observed during follow-up is a series-level sentence that does not name each patient; it is not copied to individual patients.

Tables 1-3 are also supplied as images inside the JATS table-wrap; the parser lists them as unwrapped graphics without caption links, so they stay unresolved and not EHR-includable although their rows are cases 1-4.
